body:
I had intense bodyload from these two substances combined. Even preloading with magnesium and vit-c the bruxism still made my teeth ache for days after the experience.
That being said, I've never experienced visuals as intense as I did on these two chemicals combined.  It would be too difficult to describe exactly, but there were times when my entire visual field was completely encompassed with intricate patterns.  Walls were coated in incredible patterns and everything seemed to give off energy.  There was no warping, it was more like patterns emerged from even the smallest thing.
There was also very little of the loved up feeling of MDMA, it was just a visual explosion.  However, conversation was very easy.  We talked about some amazing things and it was all very positive.
